g.text: How far later candles travel after the breakout
Full Mean-box width is the ruler.1.50× =50% beyond the breached edge. Subsequent maximum overshoot is floored at zero.
Own Wide ≥50-fit first-wick events with later candles; excludes the signal candle. Late groups can be extremely small; see the tables.
